core_obligations: Construct the embeddings (proof lines 2877-2890): for each index i the author embeds F_i into an injective sheaf G_i using functorial injective embeddings on the site at that index.

Transport the structure maps (proof lines 2890-2902): the compatibility maps between the F_i are transported to maps between the G_i along the same transition functors, which is possible because the construction is functorial, giving the required map of systems.
proof_roadmap: Embed each member of the system into an injective sheaf functorially.
Transport the compatibility maps between the members to the injective replacements.
Obtain the map of systems asserted in the statement.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a system of abelian sheaves over an inverse system of sites can be embedded into a system of injective sheaves, compatibly with the transition maps (statement lines 2854-2875, whose set-up is cited from the chapter Sites and identified by pointer). The proof uses functorial injective embeddings on each site (proof lines 2877-2890) and transports the compatibility maps along the same transition functors, which requires the functoriality of the embedding (proof lines 2890-2902). The non-formal content is this transport of the system structure. The claim is H2: one functorial construction, written out.
